title: Evidence-backed submission reconciliation and truthful dashboard counts
steps: Add confirmed-submitted, confirmed-not-submitted and still-unknown outcomes with evidence and attempt-bound validation
Expose reconciliation in the job record and blocked packet view
Retain submit-attempt evidence for future uncertain outcomes
Separate current/archived/deleted counts while preserving all-time submission metrics
Test duplicate prevention, stale checks, timeline/count preservation and UI; verify and deploy without resolving production attempts automatically
